description: 《收尸问仙》项目级规则：只对本书生效的口味与第 1 章迭代中沉淀的专属套话，不随引擎约束其他书。

clicheRules.pattern: 重重顿在[^，。！？]{0,6}地上|腰间空空如也|僵硬蜷曲|凝而不散|冷若霜针|立着三道黑影|惨白[^，。！？]{0,3}风灯
虚浮水准|应声(?:化开|碎裂)
眼下唯一的活路，便是|这笔账(?:根本)?不用再(?:往下)?细算
(?:头|前)[一二三四五]+(?:层|级)算[^，。！？]{1,8}，[^。！？]{2,20}(?:翻上一倍|成倍暴涨)|每满一[月日年]才能自行|只在经脉(?:浅表)?流转

clicheRules.remedy: This book writes item and skill names bare; the 「」 quoting that drifted into the unprocessed chapters is out of contract.

fillerRules.remedy: Cut farewell/greeting pleasantries (Early-Out rule); end dialogue immediately on stakes or action.

fillerRules.pattern: 门栓乱跳|(?:油灯|烛火)(?:也)?跟着晃个不住
fillerRules.remedy: Delete redundant prop reactions and internal emotion labels already shown by action.

registerRules.remedy: Use authentic 初/正 ke notation (e.g. 寅初/寅正) or watch drums (五更前), and plain 白日里.

registerRules.pattern: 这会儿|那会儿|一会会儿|提过一嘴|犯不着|几百号|满打满算|快过完的时候
registerRules.remedy: Replace modern Northern erhua/chatty phrases with clean neutral vernacular (此刻/当年/提过/不必/数百名).

registerRules.pattern: 仔细你的(?:脑袋|皮)|耍滑头|直咂嘴|瞧见没|我扒你的皮|冷邦邦|硬邦邦|没有一百也有八十|且说那|暗道一声不好
registerRules.remedy: Purge Qing-pingshu & TV yamen-constable cliches; use sect rule/cost pressure instead.

registerRules.pattern: 你(?:烧|写|干|忙|查)你的|我进来帮你|避避雨
registerRules.remedy: Cut chatty excuses or modern snarky banter in high-stakes classical dialogue; use stark commands.

registerRules.pattern: (?:子|丑|寅|卯|辰|巳|午|未|申|酉|戌|亥)时[四五六七八]刻
registerRules.remedy: This book's style contract writes time as chu/zheng (e.g. 寅初, 寅正); 'X shi 4-8 ke' is flagged here as a book preference, not as an error.
